reason: Changing font-awesome from a <style> stylesheet to a <script> loaded at Foot switches the icon rendering mechanism (JS SVG replacement vs CSS webfont) across the default theme and login page, which could visually affect icon rendering or break sites relying on the CSS-based approach, though it's a low-blast-radius, easily reviewable front-end change.
